source.charts: BBGG appendix: the Overview charts, the MBG-keyed verb and participle charts, and the declension, adjective and pronoun charts; the article, relative and personal pronouns from GrammarSummaries
source.patterns: Each chart is filed under the pattern the appendix prints over it: MBG's code for a noun or adjective, the verb chart's heading (thematic, contracted, liquid, athematic, second aorist) for a verb. A pronoun, the article and the irregular adjectives are each their own pattern.
source.items: A slot is an item where CenterBLC/N1904 uses it at least 20 times across its rule and 5 in its pattern, on a word occurring 20 times or more. form is the chart's; gnt_forms are up to 3 of the GNT's own, one per known word, regular forms first, none of them a word verify.WITHHELD keeps off the cards.

decl1.morph_rule_description: Case and number forms as the grammars print them.

decl2.name: Second Declension Nouns
decl2.morph_rule_description: Stems ending in omicron. Masculine nouns take -ος in the nominative singular, neuter nouns -ον, and the two differ only in the nominative and accusative.
decl2.teaching_note: Taught before the first declension because its endings are the ones the article and the 2-1-2 adjective reuse. Both drill lexemes were confirmed against the corpus to inflect exactly like λόγος.

article.name: Definite Article
article.morph_rule_description: Twenty-four forms carrying first and second declension case endings across all three genders. It is the smallest complete display of the case-ending system, and the most frequent word in the corpus.
article.teaching_note: No other word inflects like the article, so drill_lexemes is empty by nature rather than by omission. GrammarSummaries' Eight Noun Rules 2, 3 and 6 are all visible in this one chart: neuter nominative and accusative match, neuter plural ends in alpha, and masculine and neuter are identical in the genitive and dative.
